t.zh: 工作台读得出一个像素的三个数，却没有问过这三个数各是哪种颜色。一张用<wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref>读进来的照片在这里显示出来，蓝天成了橙色。这一关的问题是：同一张照片，为什么在这里显示出橙色的天空？
t.en: The workbench can read a pixel's three numbers but has never asked which colour each one is. A photo read in with <wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref> is displayed here, and its blue sky has turned orange. This level asks: why does the same photo show an orange sky here?

t.zh: 这一关要接一块电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。要把一个像素的三个数拆开、重新排，工作台还没有这样的元件。新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>取出彩色图的一个通道，设成 R、G 或 B，就是每格的第一、第二或第三个数；<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图合成一张彩色图。每个像素都和期望相符才算对。
t.en: This level wires a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. Taking a pixel's three numbers apart and putting them back in another order needs parts the workbench lacks. The new part <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref> takes one channel out of a colour image, set to R, G or B, the first, second or third number of each cell; <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images one colour image. It is right when every pixel matches the expected one.

after.zh: 各个库的<wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>不同：<wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref>读图得到 BGR，<wiki-ref to="matplotlib"></wiki-ref>按 RGB 显示。
after.en: Libraries differ in <wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>: <wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref> reads images as BGR, <wiki-ref to="matplotlib"></wiki-ref> displays RGB.

brief.zh: 输入是按 BGR 存的照片：交出同一张照片按 RGB 存的样子。
brief.en: The input is a photo stored as BGR: give the same photo stored as RGB.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个通道分别取出来看：设成 R 取出的那一张，装的是天空的什么颜色？
hint.en: Take the three channels out one by one: the one set to R, which colour of the sky does it hold?
